Rae: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — collecting owners for DNS TTL alignment + SNI/TLS retry remediation. Please ack and add ETA.

Omar: Ack. I'll own the LB healthcheck change to validate SNI earlier and add TTL alignment logic. ETA: config PR by Thu EOD.

Blake: I'll run the canary + smoke tests once Omar's PR lands. ETA: tests done by Fri morning.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-11-20 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/dns-ttl-sni-retry-pattern-2025 (auto-attached)

Mina: From logs, DNS TTL skew across edges caused short windows routing to stale backends. I'll add telemetry and a dashboard tile for ttl_skew by region. ETA: Wed.

Cal: I'll draft the on-call playbook steps and an alert runbook for TLS/SNI spikes. ETA: Fri EOD.

Omar: Draft config snippet pushed:
```yaml
healthcheck:
  prefer_sni_validation: true
  ttl_alignment_threshold_s: 20
  cross_region_retry_limit: 1
```
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2512

Blake: Canary started (5% traffic to region-e). Early signals: retry_count -30%, small SNI bump 0.12%. Monitoring 2h.

Rae: Action items recap:
- Omar: LB healthcheck + TTL alignment PR (ETA Thu EOD)
- Blake: canary + smoke (ETA Fri morning)
- Mina: telemetry & dashboard (ETA Wed)
- Cal: playbook & alert text (ETA Fri EOD)

Mina: Datadog query I'm adding:
```
sum:network.dns.ttl_skew{env:prod}.rollup(max,60)
```
Alert: ttl_skew > 20s on >2 nodes for 5m.

Blake: Canary completed 3h, no customer-facing errors. Proceeding to 30% ramp tomorrow.

Omar: PR merged and rolling. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2518. Added healthcheck tweak.

Cal: Playbook created, alert ID DD-4999. Included quick rollback steps and customer notice template.

Rae: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem tracker and close items once alert and outreach confirmations are in.
